decisions.statement: An act that writes an event reaches the calendar as Alan.
An act that only reads reaches the calendar as the account akasha runs under.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
A call the calendar threw on exits with the code that throw carries.
A throw carrying no code of its own is operational rather than of no known kind.
No guard is written here; the guard every command body runs inside is used.
An act is handed a list to name each write on as the calendar takes that write.
A call that threw is answered with what that list holds, reported and named in the refusal.
A call that threw with nothing on that list is answered as the fault alone.
No word of the call is read here; each act takes its words through the one reader.

definition: what an act on a calendar event takes, and the call that act makes
